Name: Clint Sells Diamond
Author: art107
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url] is a mod that adds upgrades to many stardew valley machines. I've been using that mod on my current playthrough and I love it. Problem is diamond is a huge bottleneck, it is hard for me to find diamond for the diamond machine. In fact It is easier for me to find iridium for the iridium machines (the next tier of upgrade) than diamond so I made this mod. This mod makes Clint sells diamond for 2500g.

Compatibility:
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- Should be compatible with most mods
- Compatible with mods that adds item to Clint shop
